# Reader

> Save links from the web. Find them, pull their content, and mark them read through ChatGPT.

Personal libraries, account records, API keys, and MCP responses are private.
Existing public guides: [Agent instructions](https://read.significanthobbies.com/agents.md) and [Access and pricing](https://read.significanthobbies.com/pricing.md).
